description: This file defines an enum LaunchdManager responsible for managing launch daemons or agents via launchctl. It includes methods to start and stop the OpenClaw application by interacting with launchctl using system processes.

methods.name: runLaunchctl
methods.description: Executes the launchctl command with specified arguments by creating and running a system process.

methods.name: startOpenClaw
methods.description: Starts the OpenClaw application by invoking launchctl with the kickstart command for the user-specific target.

methods.name: stopOpenClaw
methods.description: Stops the OpenClaw application by invoking launchctl with the stop command for the user-specific target.
